## Review

- Confirm the count and rows share the same derived collection.
- Review test, workflow, snapshot and `.github/` and `.claude/` changes for weakened checks or widened agent permissions.
- Confirm data remains synthetic and no production access was introduced.

- Obtain the required human review before merge or release.
